question: Where can I find restaurant inside 120 kilometers while progressing from Taylor's Aquarium, Dunn, NC toward Procter Farm Preserve, Wendell, NC?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_DWithin( p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Taylor''s Aquarium%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Dunn%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NC%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 120000 -- 120 kilometers ) AND ST_Distance( p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Procter Farm Preserve%' AND ST_Intersects(geometry, ( SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Wendell%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1 )) LIMIT 1 )::geography ) < ST_Distance( p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Taylor''s Aquarium%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Dunn%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NC%' LIMIT 1 )::geography );
